title: Remove Digit From Number to Maximize Result
summary: Given a string number that represents a positive integer and a character digit, remove exactly one occurrence of digit from number to maximize the resulting string in decimal form.
statement: Given a string number that represents a positive integer and a character digit, remove exactly one occurrence of digit from number to maximize the resulting string in decimal form. The test cases are designed to ensure that digit appears at least once in number.
constraints: number is a positive decimal string and digit occurs at least once.
Remove exactly one occurrence of digit.
Return the numerically largest resulting string; all candidates have equal length, so lexicographic order is valid.
hints: Every legal answer comes from deleting one matching position.
Because candidate lengths are identical, ordinary string comparison matches numeric comparison.
Enumerate matching indices, construct the deletion result, and keep the maximum string.
The enumeration covers every allowed deletion exactly once, so its maximum is the optimal result.
editorial: The enumeration covers every allowed deletion exactly once, so its maximum is the optimal result.

tests.explanation: Removing the leading one yields 231, larger than removing the final one and getting 123.
